items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 14 NOV - The International Day of Mediterranean Cuisine took place today at the Parc de l’Amitié in Niamey, marking the first-ever celebration in Niger of the UN Day of the Mediterranean Diet on November 16, established last year at the proposal of Italy and 11 other countries. items.titleIt: Mediterranean Cuisine Day Celebrated for the First Time in Niger

items.title: UN Ends Three Decades of Political Mission in Somalia
items.description: The closure of the U.N. Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNTMIS) follows a two-year transition agreed with the federal government. It was replaced by the U.N. Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNSOM) in 2013 before entering its final transition phase as UNTMIS in 2024.
